bio_en: Grigor Bulgaratsi (Kezian) came to Van in 1905, after Aram, and at once became one of the ARF's leading figures there - not an intellectual, but a core organiser of the party's underground life who often sat on the Central Committee and controlled all its arms stores. During Davo's betrayal in 1908 he was among those arrested when their hiding places were exposed. In the 1918 retreat, unable to reach the Caucasus by the Bekri road, he led some 20-25,000 people toward Baghdad. In 1919 he chaired the organising body of the 2nd Western Armenian Congress in Yerevan, and he died in 1922.
notes: Compiled from the archive review, 2026-10-12. Confidence: medium. Death year from the obituary in Chakatamart, 6 May 1922.
